properties.property: Access sets must be initialized before any address access check
properties.formal_expression: BEFORE check_address_access(addr): accessed_addresses.initialized == true AND accessed_storage_keys.initialized == true

properties.property: Sender, recipient, and all precompiles are always warm at transaction start
properties.formal_expression: AFTER initialize_access_sets(): sender IN accessed_addresses AND recipient IN accessed_addresses AND FORALL p IN precompiles: p IN accessed_addresses

properties.property: Cold address becomes warm after first access
properties.formal_expression: AFTER add_address_to_set(addr): addr IN accessed_addresses AND is_warm(addr) == true

properties.property: An address is either cold or warm, never both
properties.formal_expression: FORALL addr: XOR(is_cold(addr), is_warm(addr))

properties.property: Cold address access always costs 2600 gas
properties.formal_expression: FORALL op IN [CALL, BALANCE, EXTCODE*]: cold_access_cost(op) == 2600

properties.property: Warm access always costs 100 gas regardless of operation type
properties.formal_expression: FORALL op: warm_access_cost(op) == 100

properties.property: Cold SLOAD costs 2100 gas
properties.formal_expression: cold_sload_cost == 2100

properties.property: Out-of-gas results in operation failure and state revert
properties.formal_expression: AFTER charge_gas() WHERE gas_available < gas_required: execution_status == FAILED AND state_reverted == true

properties.property: SSTORE gas uses SLOAD_GAS of 100 and SSTORE_RESET_GAS of 2900
properties.formal_expression: SLOAD_GAS == 100 AND SSTORE_RESET_GAS == 2900

properties.property: Storage key added to accessed set after SSTORE on cold key
properties.formal_expression: AFTER sstore(addr, key) WHERE was_cold(addr, key): (addr, key) IN accessed_storage_keys

properties.property: Access set modifications revert when call scope reverts
properties.formal_expression: AFTER call_revert(): accessed_addresses == accessed_addresses_before_call AND accessed_storage_keys == accessed_storage_keys_before_call

properties.property: Access set modifications persist when call succeeds
properties.formal_expression: AFTER call_success(): accessed_addresses SUPERSET accessed_addresses_before_call

properties.property: Fixed gas sub-calls with 2300 gas cannot complete cold access operations
properties.formal_expression: WHEN gas_stipend == 2300 AND cold_access_required: cold_access_cost > 2300 IMPLIES call_will_fail

properties.property: Pre-warming allows sub-calls to succeed with warm access cost
properties.formal_expression: AFTER pre_warm(addr) THEN sub_call(addr, gas=2300): access_cost == 100 AND call_succeeds == true

properties.property: Input lengths must be parsed before multiplication complexity can be computed
properties.formal_expression: BEFORE compute_multiplication_complexity(): base_length.parsed AND modulus_length.parsed AND exponent_length.parsed

properties.property: ModExp gas cost is always at least 500
properties.formal_expression: ALWAYS modexp_gas_cost >= 500

properties.property: Gas cost equals max(500, multiplication_complexity * iteration_count)
properties.formal_expression: AFTER compute_final_gas(): gas_cost == max(500, floor(mult_complexity * iter_count))

properties.property: ModExp result is always padded to modulus_length bytes
properties.formal_expression: AFTER return_result(): len(result) == modulus_length

properties.property: Insufficient gas results in out-of-gas failure with no return data
properties.formal_expression: AFTER charge_gas() WHERE insufficient: execution_status == OOG AND return_data == empty

properties.property: Small inputs (<=32 bytes) use minimum complexity of 16
properties.formal_expression: WHEN max(base_length, modulus_length) <= 32: multiplication_complexity == 16

properties.property: Large inputs use complexity formula 2 * words^2
properties.formal_expression: WHEN max(base_length, modulus_length) > 32: multiplication_complexity == 2 * ceil(max_length/8)^2

properties.property: Large exponents use 16x multiplier in iteration calculation
properties.formal_expression: WHEN exponent_length > 32: iterations == 16 * (exponent_length - 32) + bit_length

properties.property: Transaction must be received before gas limit validation occurs
properties.formal_expression: BEFORE check_gas_limit(tx): tx.received == true

properties.property: Transaction gas limit cap is exactly 16,777,216 (2^24)
properties.formal_expression: TX_GAS_LIMIT_CAP == 16777216

properties.property: Transactions with gasLimit > 16,777,216 are rejected and not pooled
properties.formal_expression: AFTER check_gas_limit(tx) WHERE tx.gasLimit > 16777216: tx.rejected == true AND tx NOT IN mempool

properties.property: Transactions with gasLimit <= 16,777,216 pass gas limit validation
properties.formal_expression: AFTER check_gas_limit(tx) WHERE tx.gasLimit <= 16777216: tx.gas_limit_valid == true

properties.property: Blocks containing any transaction with gasLimit > 16,777,216 are invalid
properties.formal_expression: FORALL block: (EXISTS tx IN block.txs: tx.gasLimit > 16777216) IMPLIES block.invalid

properties.property: Invalid blocks are rejected and not added to chain
properties.formal_expression: AFTER validate_block_txs() WHERE exceeded == true: block.rejected == true AND block NOT IN chain

properties.property: Blocks with all transactions under cap pass this validation stage
properties.formal_expression: AFTER validate_block_txs() WHERE all_under_cap: block.gas_validation_passed == true

properties.property: Gas cap enforcement blocks high-gas DoS attacks
properties.formal_expression: AFTER enforce_cap() WHERE attack_tx.gasLimit > 16777216: attack_mitigated == true

properties.property: Block validation time is bounded due to individual transaction gas caps
properties.formal_expression: FORALL block: validation_time(block) <= f(16777216 * tx_count)
